title: rubus oigocladus var. dasycaulon
intro: Rubus oigocladus var. dasycaulon, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is known for its edible fruits, which have been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rubus oigocladus var. dasycaulon include its use as an antidiarrheal, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
